title: How to (Accidentally) Survive Islamabad Wedding Season. Tip #1
body: Count the cards on the fridge. Three in a month is normal. Eight means somebody's cousins have all hit the age at once and there is nothing anyone can do. Serena, the Convention Centre, a marquee on Kashmir Highway, or a farmhouse in Chak Shahzad, and he knows four of them by name. It's a sealed deal if he has attended a wedding where he could not identify the groom until the third hour.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 shaadi season is a full-time job.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive Islamabad Wedding Season. Tip #2
body: Watch the outfit maths, because it is a full intelligence operation. The same suit cannot appear at two functions whose photo sets overlap, and the women's side has mapped exactly who was where. There is a group chat. There are screenshots. It's a sealed deal if an outfit has been changed at the last minute purely because of who confirmed attendance.
caption:
Tip #2 😭 shaadi season is a full-time job.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive Islamabad Wedding Season. Tip #3
body: Ask about the mehndi choreography. Three weeks of practice in someone's lounge, one cousin who takes it far too seriously, one who never learned the steps and will improvise on the night. Somebody has cried at a rehearsal. It's a sealed deal if a group has fallen out over song selection and it is still referenced years later.
caption:
Tip #3 😭 shaadi season is a full-time job.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive Islamabad Wedding Season. Tip #4
body: Watch the money moment. Salami, the envelope, the counting that everyone does without appearing to. There is one uncle who does it loudly and one who does it so nobody sees, and both are making a statement. It's a sealed deal if a family has been discussed for a week afterwards over an amount.
caption:
Tip #4 😭 shaadi season is a full-time job.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive Islamabad Wedding Season. Tip #5
body: Ask how many events there actually are, because outsiders think a wedding is a day. Dholki, mayun, mehndi, barat, valima, and each has its own guest list, outfits, and arguments. By the valima everyone has been at this for a month and is running on nothing. It's a sealed deal if somebody cried over a seating chart and it was not the bride.
caption:
Tip #5 😭 shaadi season is a full-time job.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive Islamabad Wedding Season. Tip #6
body: Watch the two mothers being extremely polite to each other in a way the whole room can read. Six months of family conversation has led here and it will be discussed for years, from both sides, in detail. It's a sealed deal if you can tell which family is which purely by where they're standing.
caption:
Tip #6 😭 shaadi season is a full-time job.

title: How to (Accidentally) Survive Islamabad Wedding Season. Tip #7
body: Ask what happens at the end. The food arrives late, that's the signal, and then the room begins the ninety-minute business of leaving. Somebody's nano is still on the dance floor. Somebody's father is arguing about who is driving whom. It's a sealed deal if he has left at 1am and gone straight to a dhaba with four cousins to discuss the wedding.
caption:
Tip #7 😭 shaadi season is a full-time job.
